new_mathematical_results: Exact forced-support Fourier identity: Lhat(S)=lambda^{|S|/2} Pr(S subseteq A), hence b_j=lambda^j E binom(|A intersect A'|,j) and 1+chi^2(T_rho P||Q_p)=E(1+rho^2 lambda)^{|A intersect A'|}.

Negative-association support-mixture theorem: if nu is negatively associated and kappa(nu)=C/S_2 with C=sup_A sum_{e in A}q_e and S_2=sum_e q_e^2, then chi^2(T_rho P||Q_p) <= exp(rho^2 kappa(nu) Adv_{<=D}(P,Q_p)^2)-1 for every D>=1.
Homogeneous fixed-size uniform-marginal negatively associated laws satisfy kappa=1.
Uniform spanning-tree plant on K_n has q_e=2/n, kappa=1, b_1=2 lambda (n-1)/n, and full pre-noise chi-square bounded by exp(2 lambda (n-1)/n)-1.
